items.informal_name: Weighted Order is Non-Increasing under Scalar Multiplication
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {a : R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (a • f)
items.informal_description: For any scalar $ a $ in the semiring $ R $, the weighted order of a multivariate power series $ f $ with respect to a weight function $ w $ satisfies $ \operatorname{ord}_w(f) \leq \operatorname{ord}_w(a \cdot f) $, where $ \operatorname{ord}_w $ denotes the minimal weighted degree of non-zero monomials in the series.

items.informal_name: Meromorphic Order Invariance Under Non-Vanishing Analytic Multiplication
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {f : 𝕜 → E} {x : 𝕜} {g : 𝕜 → 𝕜},
  AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x → g x ≠ 0 → meromorphicOrderAt (g • f) x = meromorphicOrderAt f x
items.informal_description: If $ g $ is analytic at $ x $ and $ g(x) \neq 0 $, then the meromorphic order of $ g \cdot f $ at $ x $ equals the meromorphic order of $ f $ at $ x $. Formally, $ \operatorname{ord}_x(g \cdot f) = \operatorname{ord}_x(f) $.

items.informal_name: Additivity of Weighted Order under Multiplication of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g
items.informal_description: For a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ and multivariate power series $ f, g $, the weighted order of the product $ f \cdot g $ with respect to $ w $ is equal to the sum of the weighted orders of $ f $ and $ g $ with respect to $ w $. Formally, $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(fg) = \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) + \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(g) $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of a Monomial in Multivariate Power Series with Non-Zero Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, if $ f $ is a monomial $ \text{monomial}(d, a) $ where $ a \neq 0 $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to a weight function $ w: \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ is equal to the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $. In symbols, $ \text{weightedOrder}_w(\text{monomial}(d, a)) = \text{weight}_w(d) $.

items.informal_name: Order of a Multivariate Power Series
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {a : R}, f.order ≤ (a • f).order
items.informal_description: The order of a multivariate power series $ f $ is defined as the minimal total degree of a monomial in $ f $ with a non-zero coefficient. If $ f $ is the zero series, its order is $ \top $ (infinity).
